summary: IPC Alternative Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a regular monthly distribution authorized by its Board of Directors for four classes of common stock (T, D, I, X-1) with record date May 31, 2026 and payment on June 3, 2026. Gross distribution is $0.1042 per share across classes, with net amounts varying after deducting distribution fees for Class T ($0.0171 fee) and Class D ($0.0050 fee). The filing does not involve any M&A, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation. It is a routine capital distribution event with no structural change or strategic implications.
